description: This file defines React components and hooks for building accessible, form-related UI elements utilizing react-hook-form and Radix UI primitives. It includes context providers, form field components, and utility functions for managing form state and rendering form controls with validation error handling.

methods.name: useFormField
methods.description: Custom React hook that provides form field state, context, and IDs for accessibility and validation display.

methods.name: Form
methods.description: Wrapper component providing React Hook Form's context using FormProvider.

methods.name: FormItem
methods.description: Component that creates a form item container with a unique ID for accessibility.

methods.name: FormLabel
methods.description: Component rendering a label for a form input, indicating validation errors.

methods.name: FormControl
methods.description: Component rendering a form control (input, select, etc.) with proper ARIA attributes for validation.

methods.name: FormDescription
methods.description: Component providing descriptive text for a form input.

methods.name: FormMessage
methods.description: Component displaying validation error messages or other feedback.
